# Task: Generate a Branded Product Feature Icon Family

Generate 6 SVG icons as a single cohesive icon set.

## Design System (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
Every icon in this set MUST share identical visual parameters:
- Grid: 48x48px viewBox with 2px internal padding
- Stroke width: 2.5px
- Corner radius: 9999px (fully rounded/round caps on strokes)
- Visual weight: bold (thicker strokes, heavier presence)
- Style: duotone
- Primary shapes use #172A46, secondary shapes use #F7DF1E
- Purpose: branded product-feature art, not generic navigation glyphs
- Draw original geometry for the complete family; do not use an icon library
- Build each icon from one product-specific metaphor and 2–4 large shapes
- Share material, stroke, corner, layer, and accent behavior across the family
- Give every feature a distinct silhouette instead of repeating one container
- No stock glyph plus decoration, repeated badge, repeated circle, or generic app tile
- Consistent detail level across all icons
- No icon should look more complex or simpler than others in the set
- Each icon should use roughly the same number of path elements
- Icons must be recognizable at 16x16px when scaled down
- No text, letters, or numerals inside any icon
- Every icon must have a distinct, unique silhouette
## Color Palette
- Primary color: #172A46
- Secondary color: #F7DF1E

## Product Context

Nightly is a playful open-source web release studio for JavaScript component teams

## Icon Specifications

### Icon 1: "Instant Preview"
- Semantic concept: Custom/Abstract
- Visual description: An abstract icon representing "Instant Preview" — the AI should determine the best visual metaphor

### Icon 2: "Typed Confidence"
- Semantic concept: Custom/Abstract
- Visual description: An abstract icon representing "Typed Confidence" — the AI should determine the best visual metaphor

### Icon 3: "Component Canvas"
- Semantic concept: Custom/Abstract
- Visual description: An abstract icon representing "Component Canvas" — the AI should determine the best visual metaphor

### Icon 4: "Tiny Bundles"
- Semantic concept: Custom/Abstract
- Visual description: An abstract icon representing "Tiny Bundles" — the AI should determine the best visual metaphor

### Icon 5: "Living Docs"
- Semantic concept: Custom/Abstract
- Visual description: An abstract icon representing "Living Docs" — the AI should determine the best visual metaphor

### Icon 6: "Edge Release"
- Semantic concept: Custom/Abstract
- Visual description: An abstract icon representing "Edge Release" — the AI should determine the best visual metaphor

## Output Format

Return the icons as a JSON object with this structure:
```json
{
  "icons": {
    "feature-name": "<svg>...</svg>",
    ...
  }
}
```

Each SVG must:
- Use viewBox="0 0 48 48"
- Use XML namespace http://www.w3.org/2000/svg
- Be self-contained (no external references)
- Apply the design system parameters exactly as specified

## Critical Quality Requirements

1. If any two icons use different stroke widths, corner radii, or visual weights, the output is FAILED.
2. If any icon contains text, the output is FAILED.
3. If any icon is unrecognizable at 16x16px, the output is FAILED.
4. All icons must feel like they belong to the same family — consistent personality and construction.
5. A set of unrelated stock glyphs without a shared branded construction is FAILED.
